name: In Search of Anthion
label: Quest
description: In Search of Anthion: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Very well, friend. All that remains is to put the goblin's invention to the test. Word has it that Anthion was slain by the undead legions of Stratholme as he tried to enter its gates.
Try using the device there and see if, indeed, you can speak with the dead!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mokvar had you contact me? I'll do my best to help you, but first I must ask a great favor of you.
